_comment: Source catalogue for Six Flags Fiesta Texas. Heights compiled from the park Guest Safety guide; official attraction pages for cross-check.

sources.used_for: Park geometry, coasters, water slides, paths, and the venue boundary.
Height requirements and attraction names for the 2026 season.

Ride labels, food, restrooms, walking paths and queue entrances when georeferenced (illustrated handout — TPS). Acquire the map image via npm run venues:research -- six-flags-fiesta-texas --ai (LLM park-map search).

adapters.ropedrop: RopeDrop open data covers Disney/Universal parks only — not applicable to Six Flags parks in this catalogue.

research.note: LLM may propose aliases and height candidates from official HTML; code decides. LLM park-map search is required to locate guest-map image/PDF assets for tracing. Never invents coordinates.
